source_summary: Triton Knoll OFTO connects the wind farm to the onshore grid at Bicker Fen.
implication_for_current_39_row_map: Confirms Bicker Fen is a real offshore landing; does not identify FES proxy rows. The existing BICF41-to-BICF41 row should remain direct rather than an artificial link.

source_summary: Beatrice OFTO connects the wind farm to the 400 kV network at Blackhillock.
implication_for_current_39_row_map: Confirms one Blackhillock offshore connection only. It does not validate the eight proxy-source rows currently assigned to Blackhillock.

source_summary: Rampion's onshore substation is adjacent to National Grid's Bolney substation.
implication_for_current_39_row_map: Supports Bolney as a landing candidate; a proxy-to-Rampion crosswalk is still required before validating RAMW11-to-BOLN41.

source_summary: EA1 export assets terminate at an onshore substation close to the National Grid main substation at Bramford.
implication_for_current_39_row_map: Confirms the target connection class; not a validation of the BRST21, EAAW21 or NOTR11 proxy assignments.

source_summary: Orsted identifies Creyke Beck as the grid substation for its consented Hornsea Four cable route.
implication_for_current_39_row_map: Confirms a planned Creyke Beck connection. The 2025 TEC register records it as Scoping, so it is not evidence of an operational 2030 connection.

source_summary: West of Duddon Sands exports to the Heysham transformer platform.
implication_for_current_39_row_map: Confirms a Heysham offshore landing; not a validation of the five current proxy assignments.

source_summary: Hornsea One's onshore substation is adjacent to NGET Killingholme and is joined by two 400 kV cables.
implication_for_current_39_row_map: Strong target evidence for Hornsea One, but HOWR2B/HOWW2A are proxy-bus names rather than project identifiers and need a documented crosswalk.

source_summary: Greater Gabbard OFTO connects the wind farm to the onshore grid at Leiston.
implication_for_current_39_row_map: Confirms a Leiston offshore landing; not sufficient by itself to validate GREG11-to-LEIS4A.

source_summary: Walney Extension's onshore cables connect to the onshore substation at Middleton.
implication_for_current_39_row_map: Confirms a Middleton offshore landing; not a validation of WAAW11/WABW11 proxy assignments.

source_summary: Dudgeon OFTO connects the wind farm to the 400 kV network at Necton.
implication_for_current_39_row_map: Confirms a Necton offshore landing; not a validation of DUDW11/NORM41 proxy assignments.

source_summary: Seagreen exports to the 275/220 kV onshore substation at Tealing.
implication_for_current_39_row_map: Confirms Tealing's 275 kV landing; not a validation of SGRW21 without a source-project crosswalk.

source_summary: Lincs OFTO connects the wind farm to the 400 kV network at Walpole.
implication_for_current_39_row_map: Confirms a Walpole offshore landing; not a validation of LINS11-to-WALP41.

source_summary: Gwynt y Mor's onshore cables connect to the Bodelwyddan onshore substation.
implication_for_current_39_row_map: Confirms Bodelwyddan as a landing. It does not prove which of BIRK21, CONQ41 or PENT41 represents Gwynt y Mor or another project.

source_summary: London Array transmission assets include an onshore substation at Cleve Hill connected to NGET's 400 kV substation.
implication_for_current_39_row_map: Confirms a Cleve Hill offshore landing; not a validation of the four proxy assignments.
